einzeiler: A preview of the new season exploring the life and reign of Cleopatra.
kurzfassung: The season preview sets the scene for the historic naval Battle of Actium in 31 BC. Cleopatra stands on her flagship facing the formidable Roman fleet commanded by Agrippa. The upcoming podcast season will examine how she became the last pharaoh of Egypt.
stichpunkte: Two massive fleets of wooden battleships gather at the Gulf of Actium on September 2nd, 31 BC.
Over 500 ships prepare for what is about to become the largest naval battle in history.
Cleopatra leads the Royal Navy of Egypt aboard her ochre and lapis flagship with purple sails.
She has governed seven million people through famine, flood, war, and political catastrophe since age 18.
The opposing Roman fleet is commanded by Agrippa, described as Rome's finest naval mind.
Agrippa seeks to capture Cleopatra and parade her through the streets of Rome.
The podcast series explores the events and decisions that led Cleopatra to this decisive historical moment.

clips.text: Cleopatra discusses the tactical advantage of controlling the timing of the engagement while the wind holds.
Agrippa demands a definitive end to the conflict with the ultimate goal of parading Cleopatra through the streets of Rome.
